versions.changelog: Share-page top comments in the output; --insight (消费者洞察, +1 credit); fixed the script crash on success/errors (missing emit/fail)

Initial release of Xiaohongshu Note to Text skill.

- Extracts text, image descriptions, OCR results, main content, tags, likes, and favorites from Xiaohongshu (Red) notes (supports xiaohongshu.com, xhslink.com, rednote.com links and full share text).
- Provides full note content for both image and video notes (video: transcription + onscreen text).
- No Xiaohongshu account or API key required for one free summary per day; full results require a LinkDigest API Key (with free credits on signup).
- Usage via script (Python 3.8+) or direct HTTP API; supports Markdown and JSON output.
- Reads note interaction counts (likes, comments, saves), processes up to 18 images per note, caches previously accessed links for free subsequent queries.
- Privacy-focused: does not store images, videos, or user credentials; only processes public note content.
